Name: RotatableHoppers
Author: sabatorg
Description:
[b]Rotatable Hoppers
[/b]
Transform your Stardew Valley hoppers with full directional control and advanced filtering!


[b]What It Does:
[/b]This mod revolutionizes the humble hopper by allowing them to transfer items in any direction - not just downward like vanilla hoppers. Create complex automation systems by
making hoppers face Up, Down, Left, or Right to build sophisticated item sorting and transport networks.


[b]Key Features:
[/b]🔄 Full Directional Control
[img width=352,height=364]https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcQj6y1rFjPi6Om_xJigyH_VDYUlOcVqUmo_RdtdAwJ3s0KnHBovxMcC4RnQVMq5Vth3xsgacC3xOd3GUfYRH7huEQXARWnFdyh0CPmvkYLbYFOrBo8UTb1FW7XunruwW0uPUb98g?key=l8uzOa71quIB1-9Q3fhiWw[/img]
[list]
[*]Convert any hopper to face Up, Down, Left, or Right
[*]Up-facing hoppers: Pull from below, push items above
[*]Down-facing hoppers: Pull from above, push items below (vanilla behavior with filtering)
[*]Left-facing hoppers: Pull from right, push items left
[*]Right-facing hoppers: Pull from left, push items right
[/list]
[b]🎮 Multiple Control Methods
[/b][list]
[*]Modifier Keys: Hold Shift/Ctrl/Alt while placing hoppers for instant directional placement
[*]Hotkey Cycling: Use [ and ] keys (or controller triggers) to cycle through directions
[*]Right-Click Cycling: Shift+Right-click existing hoppers to change their direction
[*]UI Buttons: Interactive direction buttons in the hopper inventory screen
[*]Console Commands: left_hopper, up_hopper, right_hopper for quick creation
[/list]﻿
[img width=624,height=488]https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXe3adfTNXbqTRCgx10QMHtOaOj1MpWclXdZQGozAz5B9bXRvrGPTfDO53ACs6gRoCfzWZmc-1Mw1AQQTbOs8P0E7n5Q363hn_GMWMNZBUKV_AqhrZyOsAvTvlLl515Q9IwR5N1gFA?key=l8uzOa71quIB1-9Q3fhiWw[/img]

[b]🔍 Advanced Filtering System
[/b][list]
[*]Use items in hopper inventory as filters - only matching items will be transferred
[*]Quality filtering: Match items by star quality (optional)
[*]Quantity limiting: Set maximum amounts to transfer (optional)
[*]Smart matching: Handles processed items like flavored wines and jellies
[*]Toggle filtering: Disable for high-speed bulk transfer mode
[/list][img width=624,height=236]https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf6XYglffaWeMQDTQtOKjnehaOMkliC8rFwQh0rNjn_ByA54-__JPjblf8P3GBAuxAtxL_-VqI0t0A_7PiINb8-3ipNzpJJxQ0IiGOsTlPy-kvj5fuN3cLzPqibzyfhEy247OUvjg?key=l8uzOa71quIB1-9Q3fhiWw[/img]
[img width=624,height=121]https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfx_RwI29bpO-WkLpK4YTM5Su1JL2vfXhsPdzm1ymW4Fb15zg0Euaj_foQUjj3GlNEMOb-9XLzKkfN9X-UoKR9XXivQwT1M3iMu3aljHNnFN2oqqzGJSYfvGoDQnDG6GXyA855B_g?key=l8uzOa71quIB1-9Q3fhiWw[/img]
[img width=624,height=127]https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeWEVCdvzTIXEZbUBH9cghYq9AsUy_Z4UuIqjDBxcTk9Qy740zOu5R3aQwQawqfzdV0L2IkdF2BKl3-3_JUKadsuYiCtYBWAXfGGE7pKajAippLeE9dadj3tyFjEljaPVWCEXXM0A?key=l8uzOa71quIB1-9Q3fhiWw[/img]

[b]👁️ Visual Indicators
[/b][list]
[*]Direction arrows: Customizable colored arrows above hoppers show transfer direction
[*]Custom sprites: Beautiful UI buttons for direction selection
[*]21 color options: Choose from Black, Blue, Green, Red, Purple, and more
[*]Performance optimized: Arrows only render when needed
[/list]
[b]⚡ Performance Optimized
[/b][list]
[*]High throughput: Up to 20 stacks transferred per cycle when filtering enabled
[*]Smart indexing: Pre-indexes target containers for faster transfers
[*]Adaptive processing: Reduces frequency when filtering is disabled
[*]Unlimited chest support: Optimized handling for modded unlimited storage
[/list]
🎯 Easy Configuration
Generic Mod Config Menu integration for in-game settings
Configure hotkeys, visual options, and filtering behavior
Controller support: Full gamepad compatibility with cursor preservation
Per-save settings: Different configurations for different farms
[img width=624,height=505]https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf0ZmhFv8cB-lbZEj5rPz5qeSs0qt2SnBsqWf1_xKWKO4qm2Q8XB1Atfyt26-E7Y7s9wLDFiWJPPOKOmaRwwnwDpq7b-bW5Rd8r8TPvKPNs2Rn17HuAc1C5JWJEkeTUG5oECW7GAA?key=l8uzOa71quIB1-9Q3fhiWw[/img]

[b]How It Works
[/b]The mod uses Harmony patches to override vanilla hopper behavior while maintaining full compatibility. Each directional hopper:
[list]
[*]Pulls items from the specified source direction
[*]Applies filtering based on items in its inventory (if enabled)
[*]Pushes items to the target direction
[*]Works with both chests and machines
[*]Processes transfers every 1-2 seconds for real-time automation
[/list]
[b]Installation & Compatibility
[/b][list]
[*]Install SMAPI (required)
[*]Install Generic Mod Config Menu (recommended for easy configuration)
[*]Drop this mod into your Mods folder
[*]Compatible with Automate, Chests Anywhere, and most storage/automation mods
[/list]
[b]Perfect For
[/b][list]
[*]Factory builders creating complex production lines
[*]Perfectionists wanting precise item routing
[*]Creative builders designing elaborate automation systems
[*]Quality of life enthusiasts who want smarter hoppers
[/list]
Transform your farm's logistics with directional hoppers that work exactly how you want them to!
